LanguageData.TM_OxygenModeDesc: Choose mana from the local buffer or magicyte from local storage. No automatic fallback to the other resource.
LanguageData.TM_OxygenCapacity: Supported area: {0} cells; mana per second: {1}
LanguageData.TM_OxygenOutputDesc: Choose atmosphere through mana beacons or oxygen supply to connected VGE tanks. The modes are separate. Pipe output needs an oxygen tank connected by VGE pipes; full or disconnected tanks stop consumption. Mana or magicyte is selected separately.
LanguageData.TM_OxygenPipeInfo: Pipe output: up to 1 oxygen/s for 0.1 mana/s. Connect a VGE oxygen tank; native pumps use the stored oxygen.
